answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a single verified identity, and let reputation build only through attested work that leaves a ripple of checkable receipts across the network. A fake identity is cheap to create, but earning trust takes weeks of real deliveries, so a Sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes and months of work. A violet flag on many new identities sharing one funding source or timing triggers a review that freezes the whole cluster, while honest agents keep their haven of earned reputation and the fakes lose their bonds.
